Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class InletGuideVaneModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.InletGuideVaneModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class InletGuideVaneModel extends Object implements Serializable
Parametric inlet-guide-vane (IGV) model for a centrifugal Compressor.

At a fixed shaft speed, closing the inlet guide vanes adds pre-swirl to the flow entering the impeller. Relative to the fully-open reference chart this: reduces the developed head, reduces the polytropic efficiency, and lowers the surge flow (shifts the surge line to the left, which is what extends the machine's turndown). This class captures those three effects as simple, configurable functions of an opening fraction f in [0, 1], where f = 1 is fully open (no correction) and f = 0 is fully closed.

The defaults are generic, screening-level linear sensitivities of the form value = 1 - k*(1 - f). They are not vendor-certified; supply site-specific sensitivities (or, for rigorous work, an IGV-position chart family) when the data exist. With f = 1 every correction is the identity, so an unset IGV leaves the compressor behaviour unchanged.
